modalLead: The Bookmarks view gets a selection bar, the Containers tour catches up, and more than a hundred fixes — several of them kept bookmarks, widgets and settings from getting lost.

items.text: A selection bar. Tick rows and a bar above the list offers Edit, Re-check, Mute alerts, Export CSV and Delete. Ticking no longer opens the side panel.
Moving a bookmark to another page keeps its category's name, and an exported CSV shows category names.
Moving several bookmarks to another page no longer loses some of them.
Undo puts bookmarks back on their own page, also after you switched to another one.
A renamed category and a moved widget stay the way you left them, and bookmarks without a category are at the end of the page again.
Delete in the selection bar deletes again.
Importing into a nearly full inbox no longer removes your older links, and Undo after Keep brings the link back as it was.
The tour covers the new features and runs once more: columns, a web UI's bookmark, updates at night.
Automatic updates no longer roll back a container that was stopped, and start the old version after a rollback.
Leaving the page during Retest all no longer marks every bookmark broken.
No night-time "back online" after a maintenance window, and one alert per outage.
With a write token set, your stored keys and the server log stay out of reach of other sites.
